item.title: Stellar x Rise In Monthly Update - November 2025
item.author: Alena Atik
item.content:encoded:
# Stellar x Rise In Monthly Update - November 2025
HackStellar Istanbul breaks records with 52 projects 🇹🇷 | 250+ new projects in India 🔥 | 300+ total projects globally with 1,300+ builders 🚀 | Expanding the builder pipeline in Vietnam 🌏
### **🇹🇷 Turkey: HackStellar Istanbul & Regional Workshops**
![HackStellar Istanbul](https://files.risein.com/posts/cwazz-vs9zsaaaabkleqvqdak8p06o0ipkqaaaaaelftksuqmcc)
The highlight of November was the **HackStellar Istanbul** hackathon. The demand significantly exceeded our expectations, turning a mid-sized event into a major ecosystem gathering.
- Received **350+ applications**. - While we planned for 60 builders, we scaled to accommodate **107 participants** due to high demand. - The event resulted in **52 projects** submitted by a mix of experienced founders and first-time Stellar developers.
**🏆 Top 3 Winning Projects**
**🥇 1st Place: Stellar x402 Ecosystem**
![Stellar x402](https://files.risein.com/posts/k14rz-9k)
A complete Stellar implementation of the x402 payment protocol, making HTTP-native micro-payments possible and enabling frictionless, internet-level monetization using XLM.
Why it matters: It directly connects web standards based on HTTP 402 with Stellar, enabling practical and developer-friendly blockchain payments.
**🥈 2nd Place: Reset**
![Reset](https://files.risein.com/posts/ms_pt-2q)
DeFi yield aggregator built on Stellar, combining advanced yield farming opportunities with comprehensive insurance protection and institutional-grade risk management.
Why it matters: It brings professional-level DeFi infrastructure to Stellar, enabling users to maximize returns while maintaining robust security and risk controls.
**🥉 3rd Place: Sublayer**
![Sublayer](https://files.risein.com/posts/g23nn-2q)
A web3-focused infrastructure that enables you to manage all your subscriptions through a single centralized dashboard, built on Stellar.
Why it matters: It simplifies the complexity of managing multiple web3 subscriptions by providing unified access and control, improving user experience in the decentralized ecosystem.
**Nationwide Workshop Series**
![Workshop 1](https://files.risein.com/posts/y56m3-9k)
![Workshop 2](https://files.risein.com/posts/qtinc-9k)
![Workshop 3](https://files.risein.com/posts/tekys-9k)
![Workshop 4](https://files.risein.com/posts/onsq8-z)
Across Turkey, the **Rise In community** took the initiative to host IRL workshops in their own cities - including **Bursa, Yozgat, and Zonguldak, Ankara** - to prepare local developers for the HackStellar Istanbul hackathon. These community-led sessions resulted in **32 teams** producing projects and successfully onboarding to the Stellar network.
### **🔥 INDIA: Unstoppable Momentum**
**November Impact (India):** 1,800+ Applicants | 490+ Participants | 250+ Projects submitted across all activations
India continues to lead in sheer volume, with **9 high-impact events** in a single month, driving record-breaking participation across the subcontinent.
**Bhopal Build-A-Thon**
![Bhopal](https://files.risein.com/posts/vxgu4-z)
A 24-hour hackathon that stood out as a major success, yielding **106 projects** from over 200 participants.
**Multi-City Bootcamps**: From Bangalore (BMS, REVA, BIT) to Kolkata, we hosted intensive 2-day bootcamps focused on onboarding students and professional developers to the Stellar network.
**Ecosystem Integration:** Participation in major events like **GDG Devfest Siliguri** allowed us to introduce Stellar to diverse tech communities, resulting in 30 new projects in a single session.
![India Event 1](https://files.risein.com/posts/6jwj1-9k)
![India Event 2](https://files.risein.com/posts/m2x4q-2q)
## **🌏 Southeast Asia: Focus on Vietnam**
![Vietnam](https://files.risein.com/posts/tzv4a-2q)
The expansion into Southeast Asia is moving from initial awareness to consistent building, with a strong focus on localized developer support.
**Vietnam Workshop:** 65 builders participated in a technical "Build On Stellar" session, producing **10 project submissions** tailored to local use cases.

item.title: Stellar x Rise In Monthly Update - October 2025
item.author: Ezgi Yaltay
item.content:encoded:
# Stellar x Rise In Monthly Update - October 2025
Expanded across Asia - Vietnam & Indonesia workshops launched **🌏** | 100+ new projects in India | Turkey-wide workshop series kicked off | Bosphorus Hackathon applications open
### **🌏 Expanding into Southeast Asia**
![Vietnam workshop](https://files.risein.com/posts/fdsvk-4a15taaaaazjrefuawad4iouy4gwaaaabjru5erkjggg) ![Indonesia workshop](https://files.risein.com/posts/g--b--17wnpwaaaazjrefuawby2nawl0nbngaaaabjru5erkjggg)
In **Vietnam**, **110+ developers** came together in Hanoi for a 2-day bootcamp, one of Stellar's strongest presences in the region so far.
Just a few days later, **Jakarta** hosted its first Stellar workshop, with **29 builders** producing **25 projects** over the weekend.
Both workshops were conducted **in local languages**, making it easier for new builders to follow, experiment, and take their first steps with Stellar.
### **🔥 INDIA: Maximum Velocity**
![Pune bootcamp](https://files.risein.com/posts/cwil_-9k)![Pune buildathon](https://files.risein.com/posts/qlryi-57lj3gaaaazjrefuawbloucf8jodvqaaaabjru5erkjggg)
![Raipur BIT Durg](https://files.risein.com/posts/aux4r-9k)![Raipur IIIT](https://files.risein.com/posts/f4t2e-2q)
![Raipur projects](https://files.risein.com/posts/n86ts-9k)
In just one month, through multiple high-impact bootcamps in **Pune and Raipur**, we drove over **100+ new projects** in India alone!
We started the month in **Pune**, hosting a two-day bootcamp at **Vishwakarma University**, followed by the **Buildathon Pune** - a full-day hackathon that brought builders together for an intense weekend of coding and collaboration. Later, we moved to **Raipur**, where we ran back-to-back bootcamps at **BIT Durg** and **IIIT Naya Raipur**, introducing Stellar to a new wave of student developers.
Across these activations, more than **250 participants** joined and built over **100 projects**, many of them exploring payments, DEFI, and real-world use cases on Stellar.
The **Buildathon Pune (25–26 October)** was the highlight of the month - a 24-hour hackathon with **83 developers** and **26 project submissions**.
**🏆 Top 3 Winning Projects**
1. **0xPioneer – RenVM**: A decentralized platform for renting virtual machines globally, powered by Stellar payments and ZeroTier networking. [GitHub](https://github.com/yashranaway/vmrentals)
2. **CodeStorm – OpenStellar**: A decentralized bounty management platform using Soroban smart contracts for secure escrow functionality. [GitHub](https://github.com/Dashrath-Patel/OpenStellar)
3. **RustaceanX – EscrowX**: A decentralized freelance marketplace with DAO-based dispute resolution and zero platform fees. [GitHub](https://github.com/sushant4612/EscrowX)
### **🇹🇷 Turkey: Kicking Off the Workshop Series**
![Turkey workshop](https://files.risein.com/posts/onk7m-6mdonmaaaagsurbvamaiy4ygxcmicaaaaasuvork5cyii)
After the **HackPera Hackathon**, which brought together participants from all across Turkey, **Stellar workshops are now happening nationwide!**
We kicked off the series at **Manisa Celal Bayar University**, where more than **20 participants** built over **10 projects** during the session.
Next stops: **Ankara, Istanbul, Bursa, and Zonguldak.**
### **💻 Online Builder Challenge**
![Online challenge](https://files.risein.com/posts/f4h1c-pdyrzaaaabkleqvqdacqpipxkptylaaaaaelftksuqmcc)
Alongside the in-person events, we launched an **online Stellar Challenge in Turkey** with a **$1,000 prize pool**, running until **February 2026**. Developers can join with **full-stack projects** and continue building at their own pace. So far, we've already seen **100+ applications**, and **30 participants** who joined the prep workshops have submitted **10+ projects**.
If you missed the October activations, don't worry - the opportunity is still open. 👉 **Join the ongoing challenge** [here](https://cohorts.patika.dev/cohorts/odullu-fullstack-challenge)
### **🔜 What's Next**
![Upcoming events](https://files.risein.com/posts/esmo9-b9kwmgtewq4cb8c4dyrk2sswzxtyu4kfq9chtfs7mleb5owuikk2kzkggsbr54jfqhnlhonq7w46vdciajrqonqfiqnvpyrumtmgp4uaaaaasuvork5cyii)
As the year winds down and the holiday season approaches, we're gearing up for the **Stellar Bosphorus Hackathon**, happening **29–30 November in Istanbul** - the city that hosted *HackPera* and now preparing for its **second major Stellar hackathon**.
👉 [Apply here](https://www.risein.com/bootcamps/hackstellar-istanbul-edition-hackathon) **to join the hackathon.**
Beyond Istanbul, **November and December** will feature more **IRL Stellar workshops and hackathons** across **India and Turkey**, creating new entry points for developers and helping active builders take their projects further.
You can follow all upcoming programs and open events [here](https://www.risein.com/learn)

item.title: Stellar Hack Pera: Turkey’s Largest IRL Web3 Hackathon with 200+ Participants, 70+ Projects
item.author: Sude Özkan
item.content:encoded:
# Stellar Hack Pera: Turkey’s Largest IRL Web3 Hackathon with 200+ Participants, 70+ Projects
![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/zuez8-heaaaaasuvork5cyii)
In June 2025, [Stellar](https://stellar.org/) partnered with [Rise In](https://www.risein.com) to run a 36-hour hackathon during Istanbul Blockchain Week - and together, we delivered Turkey’s largest Web3 hackathon to date.
The goal was clear: support local builders, increase meaningful adoption of the Stellar ecosystem, attract high-quality projects with real potential and create on-chain value.
### **Key Results**
- 🧑‍💻 **200+ developers on-site**, selected from 500+ applications - 🔥 **72 projects submitted**, 10 awarded a share of **$25,000 in prizes** - 🎯 1 winning team launched on Stellar mainnet during the hackathon - **and started gaining traction with 100+ users** within hours - 🚀 **40% of winners were alumni** of the Rise In x Stellar Bootcamps - and the remaining winners were active members of the Rise In community. - 👩‍🦰**~25% of participants were women**. - 🌍 **50+ travel scholarships** provided, ensuring national and international access - 🌟 **Participant satisfaction score: 4.86/5** - ✅ **Participation from both newcomers and elite builders **(incl. past grant winners) - 🤝 **Every project received mentorship** from Stellar & Rise In teams and past Stellar grantees
## A Hackathon Like No Other - at the Historic Pera Palace
**Hack Pera** took place at **Pera Palace**, one of Istanbul’s most iconic and historic venues - a place that has hosted diplomats, writers, and dreamers for over a century. It's said that Agatha Christie wrote *Murder on the Orient Express* here, drawn by the building’s timeless energy.
That energy shaped our approach: **What happens when you code the future in a place built for the past?** The result was a 36-hour immersive experience that blurred the lines between past and future. Teams:
- **Coded day and night**, without sleep - **Joined workshops and mentoring sessions** with ecosystem professionals and Rise In team - **Built working prototypes from scratch**
“Hack to the Future” wasn’t just a theme - it became the mindset. A reminder that the future isn’t something we wait for. It’s something we build - line by line, block by block.
![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/1nbme-xvdpr3xl7u0qaaaabjru5erkjggg)![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/ftar7-2q)
![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/mx9of-p8it3olrjejzaaaaaelftksuqmcc)![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/hzb66-z)
![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/__jss-2q)![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/zgtse-9k)
## Why This Hackathon Was A Success
#### **1. Top of the Funnel Pipeline Worked**
Before the event, we ran a Stellar Bootcamp focused on both technical foundations and use-case development. Many participants applied what they learned directly into their hackathon projects - leading to higher quality outcomes.
One winning team** even launched on mainnet during the hackathon** and **began gaining traction with 100+ users**. Several others are now **progressing toward SDF grants** - clear signs that the builder pipeline is working.
![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/_5fu--)![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/vbfex-azohhj8qbwiaaaaaelftksuqmcc)
#### **2. Mentorship That Actually Moved Projects Forward**
This wasn’t surface-level feedback. It was a **full-stack builder support system**, from onboarding to launch - and beyond.
Over 36 hours, the **Stellar team showed up in full force** - with more than 10 team members on-site, offering 1:1 technical guidance, answering questions in real time, and making sure no builder felt stuck or lost. To ensure clear communication, professional translators were on-site.
At the same time, the Rise In team offered continuous support across business strategy, technical guidance, and team motivation.
Local mentors - including past Stellar grantees - worked closely with over 70 teams, helping them validate ideas and unblock problems in real time.
#### **3. Real Builders, Real Projects - Why Experienced Builders Showed Up and Stuck Around**
Most hackathons don’t attract experienced developers - they’re too basic or lack meaningful follow-up.
This one did.
Nearly half of all participants were past grant recipients, hackathon winners, experienced devs or startup founders. They joined because they saw:
Top builders joined because they saw:
- 🧑‍💻 Consistent, hands-on support from Stellar & Rise In - before, during, and after the event - 🧭 A clear path beyond the weekend - toward grants, network support and real traction - 🤝 A trusted, active local community
Builders left the event not just with ideas - but with pathways to grants, product feedback, and further ecosystem integration.
This wasn’t just about prizes. It was about building something that could last - and they knew it.
**4. Community Was the Advantage**
Participants weren’t strangers - many had already met through Rise In’s bootcamps and builder programs. During the hackathon, they supported each other as much as they competed: sharing ideas, solving problems together, and genuinely rooting for each other’s success.
That collaborative energy was reinforced by mentors like **Mert Kaya ([Blockera](https://x.com/blockera_online)), Cihan Dağdeviren ([StableJack](https://x.com/StableJack_xyz)), and Arda Gülbahar ([XBANK](https://x.com/the_xbank))** - local Stellar grant recipients who had been through the journey themselves - and came back to support the next generation of builders.
It didn’t feel like a contest. It felt like momentum.
## What Rise In Delivered
Execution at Scale, Without Compromising Quality -200+ developers. 72 submissions. Zero chaos.
We managed every part of the experience from application and team selection to logistics, workshops, mentorship, and judging with clarity and care. Everything worked. Seamlessly.
Rise In weren’t just the local partner, were the engine:
- Designed and ran a **high-impact builder education program** - **Curated and filtered 500+ applications **to select high-signal participants - Ensured developer quality through pre-selection and mentorship - Provided **on-site logistics, mentorship, workshops, and tech support** - Created a **culture of excellence and collaboration**, not just participation - Delivered **real projects, not just demos** - Created a trust-based community environment
This wasn't just a weekend event, it was a **strategic ecosystem activation**, with long-term outcomes already underway.
## Winners of the Hack Pera
![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/knitp-2q)![Image](https://files.risein.com/posts/8ewri-2q)
**Consumer Track**
- 1st Place - **Kale Predict**: A Soroban-based prediction market where users bet KALE tokens on future contract activity. An admin sets thresholds, and users predict "Higher" or "Lower" - with winnings distributed proportionally from the opposing side’s stake. - 2nd Place -[Luminate](https://pera-luminate.vercel.app/): A decentralized publishing platform on Stellar that uses AI and on-chain incentives to gamify content creation and reward engagement. (on Mainnet) - 3rd Place - **BrainOn**: Featured a custom hardware integration, turning brainwaves into on-chain actions on Stellar. Think. Trigger. Transact. - actions on Stellar. - 4th Place - **DJai**: An AI-powered music platform that generates personalized, copyright-free beats and streams them 24/7 - with Stellar handling secure payments and a blockchain-based revenue model. - 5th Place - [Oblivion](https://oblivion-six.vercel.app/):A zero-fee content and education platform built on Stellar, offering censorship-resistant publishing, AI-powered business tools, and cryptographic ownership through Forever Post™ technology.
**DeFi& Infra Track**
- 1st Place - [Riskon](https://riskon.vercel.app/): An on-chain credit scoring system that enables undercollateralized lending on Stellar - bringing more flexible, reputation-based access to capital. - 2nd Place - [PayStream](https://paystream.vercel.app/): A payroll solution built on Stellar that enables employees to receive their salaries in real time - with the ability to request credit from employers based on individualized risk assessment. - 3rd Place - **Parallax**: Instant, cross- chain liquidity for Ethereum liquid - staking assets on Stellar. - 4th Place -[ Steptions](https://steptions-app.vercel.app/): The First Options Protocol on Stellar. Insure any asset. Hedge price risk. Earn yield. - 5th Place -** FlashPerp**: A perpetual futures exchange built on Stellar - offering fast, decentralized trading with a focus on scalability and user experience.
## What’s Next?
Several teams are now preparing Stellar grant applications. Others are iterating on their projects and connecting with ecosystem partners. And a new cohort of developers, many of them first-time Stellar users, now see it as their primary development environment.
This event showed us that:
- When education is tied to action, builders show up prepared - Local execution partners bring crucial context and momentum - Strong communities don’t just build, they help each other grow
